defects.title: Omitting the documented optional inputs stops with an error
defects.trigger: findSparseMode([1 2], 3, false, model, LPproblem, 1e-4) (also 7 or 8 inputs) on the chain R1 (-> A), R2 (A -> B), R3 (B ->)
defects.observed: error 'Not enough input arguments.' at line 43 (6 inputs) or line 50 (7, 8 inputs); isempty on adaptiveScalingFlag/nonPen without exist, so the epsilon (line 40) and basis (line 36) defaults are unusable
defects.expected: adaptiveScalingFlag, basis, nonPen are documented OPTIONAL INPUT and epsilon has a documented default; the 6-input call should return [1;2;3] like the full 9-input call

defects.title: An empty set P returns no support although reactions of J carry flux
defects.trigger: findSparseMode([1 2], [], false, model, LPproblem, 1e-4, 0, [], []) on the same chain
defects.observed: Supp = [] (LP7 finds K = [1 2] active, LP10 returns [] at once for empty P, line 71 takes the support of []); via fastcore(model, 1:3, 1e-4, 0) on the consistent chain, fastcore warns that the global network is not flux consistent and ignores the irreversible core reactions R1, R2, R3
defects.expected: [] only if no reaction of J can carry flux above epsilon (help text); here the LP7 support [1;2;3]

notes: Reproduction (gurobi, R2025a): S = sparse([1 -1 0; 0 1 -1]); model.S = S; LPproblem = struct('A', S, 'b', zeros(2,1), 'csense', ['E';'E'], 'lb', zeros(3,1), 'ub', 10*ones(3,1)); findSparseMode([1 2], 3, false, model, LPproblem, 1e-4) -> 'Not enough input arguments.' (line 43); findSparseMode([1 2], 3, false, model, LPproblem, 1e-4, 0, [], []) -> [1;2;3]; findSparseMode([1 2], [], false, model, LPproblem, 1e-4, 0, [], []) -> []. Fastcore illustration: m2 = createModel({'R1','R2','R3'}, {'R1','R2','R3'}, {' -> A[c]', 'A[c] -> B[c]', 'B[c] -> '}); m2.lb(:) = 0; m2.ub(:) = 10; fastcore(m2, 1:3, 1e-4, 0) warns 'Global network is not flux consistent, ignoring the following irreversible core reactions' listing R1, R2, R3 (it then errors in removeUnusedGenes line 48 on this createModel model, 'logical indices contain a true value outside of the array bounds' - a separate issue of fastcore/removeUnusedGenes, not investigated). Reach for the lead: defect 1 (error) is confined to calls with fewer than 9 inputs; both src calls (fastcore lines 100 and 127) pass 9, so seed NONE. Defect 2 (wrong-result) depends on data, not on a call form: fastcore passes an empty P whenever every reaction is in the core (line 97) or once P minus A is empty in its loop (line 124), so fastcore is the seed (default reach). Attribution alternative: the root is LP10's early return for empty P (LP10 lines 35-36, pinned without defect in wave 32 testLP10); findSparseMode's own help text is what the result contradicts, so it is recorded here. The quarantine-seeds.tsv entry getCobraSolverParams -> findSparseMode is moot now that getCobraSolverParams reads the global settings (per lead). Same pattern exists in findSparseModeWeighted.m (not checked).
confirmed_by: lead (read the code: line 43 tests isempty(adaptiveScalingFlag) without exist, so the documented optional inputs cannot be left out; LP10 (line 35) returns early for an empty P, so findSparseMode returns [] although reactions of J carry flux; default seed: fastcore passes an empty P depending on the data (the error form, fewer than 9 inputs, is not used by fastcore))

defects.title: Every call stops with an error because LP7 is called with the wrong arguments
defects.trigger: fastcc_nonconvex(model, 1e-4, 0) with model = struct('S', sparse([1 -1 0; 0 1 -1]), 'lb', zeros(3,1), 'ub', 10*ones(3,1), 'rxns', {{'R1';'R2';'R3'}}) (any input)
defects.observed: error 'Dot indexing is not supported for variables of this type.' in LP7 line 38: line 61 calls LP7(J, model, epsilon) but LP7 is LP7(J, model, LPproblem, epsilon, basis), so epsilon is used as LPproblem
defects.expected: A, the n x 1 indicator of the flux consistent reactions (all three for the chain)

notes: Reproduction (gurobi, R2025a): model = struct('S', sparse([1 -1 0; 0 1 -1]), 'lb', zeros(3,1), 'ub', 10*ones(3,1), 'rxns', {{'R1';'R2';'R3'}}, 'mets', {{'A';'B'}}, 'b', zeros(2,1), 'c', zeros(3,1)); fastcc_nonconvex(model, 1e-4, 0) -> LP7 line 38 'Dot indexing is not supported for variables of this type.'. Every line after 61 is unreachable for any input. No src callers (seed reaches nothing). New test folder test/verifiedTests/reconstruction/testDCA (no existing test for src/.../fluxConsistency/DCA). Suspected further defects behind the error, unconfirmed because unreachable: line 286 sets subLPproblem.obj, but solveCobraLP reads .c, so the DCA objective never changes; line 131 'save A A' writes into the current folder; help says A is an n x 1 boolean but line 64 returns indices.
confirmed_by: lead (read the code: line 61 calls LP7(J, model, epsilon) while LP7 takes (J, model, LPproblem, epsilon, basis), so epsilon is passed as LPproblem; no src caller)
